items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: When did you join Paul's band? Do you remember about what year it was?

ctx.x: But just like I said, this New Orleans music, I love him. That's all I know, but it was a good while that I had a chance to really, you know, do it up until Paul gave me the chance, see. Cause all, I would be playing, you know, sort of commercial music.
When did you join Paul's band? Do you remember about what year it was?
